milestone: PALT-M2 — Palette Contract and Parametric Layout Kernel

authority.usage_restriction: design and validation only — never supplier or tooling geometry

palt_m1_correction_applied.enforcement: the module is the POCKET module (nominal pan + 2 x tolerance) and MODULE_SMALLER_THAN_PAN_FOOTPRINT fires when a pan cannot fit its own module; both layout modes are first-class

palt_p1_feasibility.conclusion: the proposed 92 mm depth cannot hold three rows of 26 mm pans together with hinge and clasp reservations at ANY permitted spacing — the depth is the binding constraint, not the width
palt_p1_feasibility.binding_constraint: DEPTH (the hinge + clasp reservations plus three 26.6 mm pocket modules and margins exceed 92 mm at every permitted spacing)

exit_criteria.palt_p1_valid_layout_note: the layout resolves deterministically; it is VALID in the minimum feasible case and INVALID in the owner's provisional 116x92x15 — reported, never forced

corrected_feasibility_classifications.PALT_P1_PAN_LAYOUT: 3 x 3 OF 26 MM ROUND PANS — RETAINED; NOT reduced to 3x2 to preserve a footprint

116x92x15.explicitly_not: NOT PROVEN INFEASIBLE UNDER ALL MECHANISM STRATEGIES
116x92x15.correction: the PALT-M2 conclusion overreached: it tested ONE mechanism strategy (internal reserved bands) and ONE hinge edge. PALT-M3 tests alternatives.

explicitly_not: NOT A FINAL PREMIUM PRODUCT SIZE
